about_variants:
I build agentic AI systems where verification matters, not prompt demos. My work spans generative media pipelines (ComicMainEngine), budget-gated LLM scene direction (Procedural City), and research reproduction (BeamDojo / Isaac Lab locomotion), all wired into a multi-repo ops dashboard (Venture Fleet Control Plane) with phase gates, spend tracking, and schema-backed evals.

Education: BTech Computer Science, IIT Kharagpur; MS Computer Science, UMass Amherst. Before grad school I spent three years at Mastercard shipping PCI-aware microservices, REST/ASP.NET for Enhanced Currency Conversion (~20% latency reduction), tokenization key-block compliance, and Java gateway modernization. At UMass Biomedical NLP I worked on LLM diagnosis ranking on clinical text (MIMIC-EXT-IV / RARE).

I'm looking for applied AI / agent engineer roles where production discipline (evals, provenance, cost ceilings) meets fast iteration. Open to backend-heavy GenAI platform teams too.

Agent engineer with a backend spine: BTech CS at IIT Kharagpur, MS CS at UMass Amherst, and three years at Mastercard building high-volume payment APIs. I ship FastAPI services with structured outputs, per-call usage accounting, and hard spend ceilings, then prove quality with automated eval gates instead of manual review loops.

Recent builds: ComicMainEngine (end-to-end generative comic pipeline with VLM rubric gates), Procedural City (92-phase 3D pipeline with LLM scene director + jsonschema validation), and BeamDojo (Isaac Lab locomotion reproduction on Lambda GPU). Venture Fleet Control Plane is my steward dashboard syncing STATUS, phases, and expenses across ventures.

Interested in roles building tool-using agents, multi-step workflows, and eval-first LLM products, not robotics-first positioning unless the team wants sim-to-real research.

I design LLM-powered products like backend systems: schemas, job queues, provenance logs, and cost controls from day one. Portfolio focus is agentic generative media and ops tooling, ComicMainEngine, Procedural City, BeamDojo, backed by a live command center that syncs venture state across repos.

BTech Computer Science (IIT Kharagpur) and MS Computer Science (UMass Amherst). Mastercard taught me how to ship under compliance pressure (PCI, tokenization, ECC latency). UMass BioNLP taught me how to benchmark clinical LLMs with Recall@k metrics. I combine both when building agents that must be auditable and affordable at scale.

Seeking applied AI / agentic engineering roles (and selective AI backend/platform roles) in 2026.
